London is a city layered with history, culture, and unmissable experiences. If you are planning to visit London this year, do not miss some corners of the city with amazing stories to tell and unforgettable memories to weave. This world-class capital of England is a vibrant destination for all travel enthusiasts. But how do you make each moment of your trip to London count? The city is too rich in options, and we have carefully selected some of them for you. If you wonder which place to go first and what to do to take in the city’s charm, here are the 15 things to do in London for an extraordinary experience.

Pack your bags and take a look at our quick list to explore London in the best way possible on your next trip. Read on to find out more!

## **List of 15 Best Things To Do On Your Next Trip To London**

If you like a good afternoon tea, there’s just a place for you in London. For those who want to take romance to the next level, many London attractions can be a perfect backdrop for your tale of love. Wondering about incredible food options or markets to shop for souvenirs? London has it all. Even Benjamin Franklin once said- “_**London is a roost for every bird.**_” 

Here is our carefully curated list of 15 best things to do in London for a perfect experience.

* Experience the Changing of the Guard
* Visit the Natural History Museum
* Watch a Cabaret Performance at Copacabana
* Explore God’s Own Junkyard
* Visit the Sky Garden
* Cruise on the River Thames
* Wander Through Camden Market
* Watch a live show or musical at West End
* Have Afternoon Tea at Great Court Restaurant
* Admire the Modern Art at Tate Modern
* Catch a View from The Shard
* Take a Yeoman Warder Tour
* Take a Helicopter Ride Over London
* Book a London Day Trip
* Visit Benjamin Franklin’s House

### **1. Experience the Changing of the Guard**

**![Buckingham Palace](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061358.webp)**

_**Location–Buckingham Palace**_

_**Best For– Families and those into History and Tradition**_

_**Major Attractions- **Guard changing ceremony, palace gardens, staterooms, royal lifestyle experiences_

The Changing of the Guard is a formal military ceremony at Buckingham Palace where one group of soldiers leaves duty, and the new group replaces them. It is a quintessential experience in London, offering a deep dive into British royal traditions. It is a free and fascinating way to experience the regal heritage of this royal capital. Both kids and adults can enjoy watching the Queen’s Guard hand over their duties to their peers in their iconic red uniforms. It is also one of the best family-friendly activities to experience in London.

_**When To Watch– **August to May on Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday around 10:45 a.m. June and July daily at the same time._

### **2. Visit the Natural History Museum**

![South Kensington](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061427.webp)

_**Location– South Kensington**_

_**Best For– Everyone who likes history and science**_

_**Major Attractions –** Dinosaur Gallery, Guy the Gorilla, Moa bone fragment and skeleton, Earthquakes and Volcanoes_

The Natural History Museum is a knowledge haven and one of the best free things to do in London. It offers incredible experiences for history buffs, curious travelers, and science lovers. The museum has several exhibitions that include life-sized dinosaur skeletons, collections of Earth’s geology, interactive displays, and more. It also offers hours of exploration with options ideal for both adults and kids, making it one of the best things to do in London, UK, on your next trip.

_**Best Time to Visit– **Go by 3:00 or 4:00 p.m. to avoid waiting time or crowd._

### **3. Watch a Cabaret Performance **

**![Copacabana or The London Cabaret Club](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061453.webp)**

_**Location- Copacabana or The London Cabaret Club**_

_**Best For– watching live performances, burlesque, and cocktails**_

_**Major Attractions – **The Samba Dance, West End Stars Performance, British tapas-inspired menu_

Watching a cabaret performance is the best thing to experience London nightlife and Copacabana is the best spot for that. You can also catch dazzling cabaret performances, enjoy live music, and watch burlesque shows and circus at the London Cabaret Club. Both these amazing locations offer you the perfect night out of your boring routine. There are cocktails, entertainment, and glamour packed into each performance here. 

_**Best Time For Watching– **_7:15 to 7:30 for a preshow, arrive by 6:30 for a perfect experience.

### **4. Explore God’s Own Junkyard**

**![Shernhall St, Near Walthamstow Central Station](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061515.webp)**

_**Location– Shernhall St, Near Walthamstow Central Station**_

_**Best For– Neon Art Lovers and Insta-worthy photos**_

_**Major Attractions– **Neon Lights, Film Props, the Rolling Scones Cafe, Bracey’s artwork_

Art lovers who have visited London highly recommend God’s Own Junkyard to others. It is one of the best free art exhibitions in London, offering quirky and colorful signs, artworks, and other glowing installations. Although you’d never run out of things to do in London, without visiting this perfect spot, your trip will be somewhat incomplete. If you would love to click a few Instagram-worthy photos, add God’s Own Junkyard to your bucket list. P.S. It is a hidden gem in East London for art lovers and is totally free to visit. Looking just ordinary on the outside, it offers a spectacular kaleidoscopic collection of artwork inside.

_**When to Visit– **It is open only on weekends (Fri-Sun). Visit in the evenings for the best experience (before 6:00 p.m.)_

### **5. Visit the Sky Garden**

**![The Fenchurch Building (The Walkie-Talkie)](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061548.webp)**

_**Location– The Fenchurch Building (The Walkie-Talkie)**_

_**Best For– Panoramic views of London’s skyline, Budget exploration**_

_**Major Attractions–** 360-degree London View, African Lilies, Bird of Paradise, Fenchurch restaurant, special events_

The highest public garden in London- the Sky Garden, is located at the Fenchurch Building also known as the Walkie Talkie Building at Fenchurch Street. You can visit here for free and enjoy the most spectacular views of the entire city. If you are in London with your partner and looking for a romantic date idea, it is the best place for you. Watch the sunset over the city’s skyline and take a walk through the lush green indoor garden hands in hand with your partner. You can even grab a drink from the bar or simply soak in the panoramic views without spending a single penny.

_**Best Time to Visit– **Early mornings with no crowds or at sunset for amazing views._

### **6. Cruise on the River Thames**

![Embarkation at Westminster Pier, Tower Pier or Greenwich Pier](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061614.webp)

_**Location– Embarkation at Westminster Pier, Tower Pier or Greenwich Pier**_

_**Best For– Sightseeing, Couples, and First-time visitors**_

_**Major Attractions–** the Tower of London, Shakespeare’s Globe, Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Hampton Court Palace, Cutty Sark_

If it's your first time in London, a River Thames cruise is something you should never miss. It is one of the best things you can do in London for an amazing experience without going over budget. There are several cruise options available, like sightseeing tours, dinner cruises, evening jazz cruises, and more to suit different needs and budgets. Take a 40-minute cruise along the River Thames or include it with an additional attraction for a perfect experience (_ticket prices starting-£19.50_). You can also try London Boat Tours from London Eye- and spot the popular places to visit in London from the water.

_**Best Time For Cruise– **try late afternoon or early evening on Weekdays._

### **7. Wander Through the Camden Market**

**![Camden Town. London](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061630.webp)**

_**Location– Camden Town. London**_

_**Best For– Shopping, live music, and street food**_

_**Major Attractions – **Stables Market, Dingwalls, Lane7, Photomatic event, Secret Food Tours_

The Camden Market in the English capital, London, is a diverse community of street food trades, creative sellers, and independent stores. This market has a variety of cultures, cuisines, and creativity throughout. You can shop in one of its amazing shops or try the delicious food options in one of the food stalls. There are often live performances to suit each type of traveler. This market also offers exciting things to do in London with kids. So, do not miss visiting Camden Town on your next trip to the city.

_**Best Time to Visit- **Early morning on weekdays for bargains and lunchtime for delicious food._

### **8. Watch A Live Show Or Musical At West End**

**![Victorica Palace Theatre, Lyceum Theatre, or more West End Theatres](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061650.webp)**

_**Location– Victorica Palace Theatre, Lyceum Theatre, or more West End Theatres**_

_**Best For– Theater and opera lovers, live entertainment**_

_**Major Attractions– **The Mousetrap, Back to the Future Musical, Leicester Square, Mamma Mia!, The Lion King, The Phantom of the Opera_

The best theater productions in London are found in the West End of London. It is home to several iconic theatres with live shows, performances, and musicals running all year round. You can watch the long-running show The Phantom of the Opera or catch a Lion King Musical performance at the Lyceum Theatre. Go to Leicester Square and find the best live music venues in London for a perfect experience in the West End. You can also watch Hamilton at the Victoria Palace Theatre or find other famous performances with live entertainment.

_**When to Visit– **November to Early January for the best shows_

**Read More - **[**Best Places To Visit In London**](https://www.nowtobook.com/blog/places-to-visit-in-london)

### **9. Have Afternoon Tea at Great Court Restaurant**

![The British Museum, Bloomsbury](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061713.webp)

_**Location– The British Museum, Bloomsbury**_

_**Best For– A Royal and historical experience**_

_**Major Attractions– **mezzanine floor, European-style dishes, communal dining_

Skip the pricey afternoon tea at famous restaurants like Ritz and Palm Court, and choose to have afternoon tea at the British Museum, London. The museum showcases the history of the United Kingdom in a new light. You can sip your favorite tea in between of your discovery session of its famous treasures and experience England’s rich history. Many famous tea hotspots of London are not kid-friendly which this Great Court Restaurant in the British Museum can be a good alternative for. Take your kids along and spend your afternoon sipping aromatic tea after a day full of strolls.

_**Timings- **Book in advance and arrive before 4:00 p.m. as no new sittings are allowed after that._

### **10. Admire the Modern Art at Tate Modern**

![Bankside, London](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061738.webp)

_**Location– Bankside, London**_

_**Best For–admirers of modern and contemporary art.**_

_**Major Attractions– **Fountain by Marcel Duchamp, Marilyn Diptych by Andy Warhol, Turbine Hall, Modigliani and Mondrian_

Tate Modern is a modern art gallery located in Bankside, London, England. It showcases some of the best modern and contemporary art pieces and works from famous artists across the world. It is a totally free-to-visit experience, and you can find various sculptures, paintings, and large-scale installations from big names like Yayoi Kusama and Pablo Picasso. Henri Matisse, and more. Tate Modern also features several exhibitions throughout the year for art enthusiasts from budding and famous artists.

_**The Best Time to Visit– **Weekday mornings for the quietest experiences and have more time to admire the art._

### **11. Catch a View from The Shard**

![London Bridge Street](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061759.webp)

_**Location– London Bridge Street**_

_**Best For– Exclusive and Panoramic Views with rich experience**_

_**Major Attractions- **Viewing Platform, Aqua Shard, Hutong, Oblix, The Slide_

You can catch breathtaking views of London city from the View from the Shard at London Bridge street. The View from the Shard is a 72-story skyscraper and one of the tallest buildings in London, United Kingdom, meanwhile the 7th tallest in Europe. The viewing platform is located on the top floors 68, 69 and 72. You can gaze across the entire city with this point and enjoy exciting views from a high vantage point. Take at least 45 to 60 minutes to catch all the details of the city. The tickets can be purchased at the location, or you can buy Fast Track tickets in advance to save time.

_**The best time to Visit– **around 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. for a magical experience._

### **12. Take a Yeoman Warder Tour **

![The Tower Of London, Tower Hill](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061818.webp)

_**Location– The Tower Of London, Tower Hill**_

_**Best For– History and Royal Heritage**_

_**Major Attractions– **Traitor’s Gate, the scaffold site, The Bloody Tower, the medieval palace, The White Tower, The Ravens, the Armoury in action_

The Tower of London is a UNESCO World Heritage site with several tales of its everlasting history. Back in the 1000s, it was used both as a prison and a royal residence. Today, this iconic fortress houses the Crown Jewels. You can take a Yeoman Warder Tour of this iconic tower and learn more about it. Yeoman Warders, also known as Beefeaters, will share the major stories from 1000 years back in history with you. Find out ticket prices and more with Nowtobook and book tickets to experience London uniquely.

_**When to Visit–**_ Mornings or late afternoon; avoid weekends if you do not want extra crowds.

**Read More - **[**Places To Visit Near London**](https://www.nowtobook.com/blog/places-to-visit-near-london)

### **13. Try a Helicopter Ride To See London From The Skies**

![Departure from Battersea Heliport](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061842.webp)

_**Location– Departure from Battersea Heliport**_

_**Best For- Adventure Lovers, Couples, and Photographers**_

_**Major Attractions– **Houses of Parliament, The City, St Paul’s, The Globe Theatre, Thames River, Tower Bridge, Canary Wharf, Olympic Stadium_

You can travel the entire city on foot and explore all the places to visit in London. But if you are searching for the most epic things to do in the city, taking a helicopter tour is something you must try. This tour gives you extraordinary aerial views of famous London landmarks like Buckingham Palace, The Tower of London, The Shard, and more. A typical ride lasts around 50 minutes to 1 hour. Check out different ride options and your departure place can also vary based on that.

_**When To Ride– **Spring and Summer during midday, around 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m._

### **14. Book a London Day Trip**

![Several departures and drop-off points](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061904.webp)

_**Location– Several departures and drop-off points**_

_**Best For– The whole exploration of London City**_

_**Major Attractions– **Bath, Stonehenge, Canterbury, Westminster Abbey, Windsor Castle_

Will you be in London for at least 4-5 days? Book exciting day trips from London and explore the heart of England at its best. A royal residence- Windsor Castle can be explored in half a day, and you can even add Stonehenge to your day trip. Other options include a visit to Bath and Stonehenge, including the White Cliffs of Dover on your trip for a better experience. Or plan a day trip to the Cotswolds.

_**Booking Tip–**_ Book a day trip that leaves early in the day and offers maximum exploration options.

### **15. Visit Benjamin Franklin’s House**

**![36 Craven St, London?](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024061922.webp)**

_**Location– 36 Craven St, London **_

_**Best For– Literature tours, Book Club, Architecture tours**_

_**Major Attractions- **Educational Programs, Private Events, Photoshoots, Medical history Room_

If you have been a fan of Benjamin Franklin’s original works, you can pay a visit to his house in London. He lived in London for 16 years in the late 1700s and called this house located at 36 Craven Street his home. Today it is turned into a museum as it's the only house where you can still find some of his works. 

_**Best Time To Visit– **Fridays for architectural tours, Sat-Sun for historical experiences._

### **Concluding**

London has a diverse range of experiences available for every visitor. Try a helicopter ride to see it through the high skies, or book a day trip to experience everything from the grounds. The city is a treasure trove of incredible things to do and places to visit. You can also visit this amazing capital city of England and be amazed by its neverending charm. Need more information on events, art exhibitions, or live performances? Check out our various options for flights to London and book with Nowtobook. We can help you tour London with the best packages and flight options.

### **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Q: What are the top things to do in London for first-time visitors?**

**A: **The top things to do in London for first-time visitors include:

* Visit to the Buckingham Palace in London
* watch the changing of the Guard
* Seeing the Big Ben
* Explore the Tower of London. 

#### **Q: What are the best outdoor activities in London?**

**A: **The best outdoor activities in London include-** **

* A visit to the Hyde Park
* Taking a cruise on the River Thames
* Explore an outdoor theatre

#### **Q: What are some unique things to do in London? **

**A: **The most unique things to do in London, England, include 

* glow-in-the-dark drawing
* meeting some unusual robots
* 18th-century London life experience
* exploring the weirdest museum on Mare Street.

#### **Q: When is The Best Time To Visit London?**

**A: **The best time to visit London is between June and August for warm and pleasant weather. Some attractions may look better in the winter, but overall this period is preferred for the best climate and amazing views.

#### **Q: Is there anything fun to do in London?**

**A: **There are many fun rides in London and other options for an exciting getaway. You can take a London Helicopter Ride, visit the museums and galleries, book a day trip to Stonehenge and Bath, and much more.

#### **Q: What is the most popular thing in London?**

**A: **London is famous for a lot of things. You can watch Buckingham Palace- the official residence of the British monarch, visit Big Ben London, visit the gothic masterpiece- Westminster Abbey, or explore art galleries that display fabulous works of art.

## International Destinations To Visit In May- 7 Wonderful Places

When the scent of blooming flowers fills the air, and we are already in May, it’s like an invitation to modern-day nomads for a new adventure. This beautiful month is a perfect time to wake our hibernating souls from their winter slumber and plan an international vacation. If you are also yearning for a holiday to a global wonder, we have got your back. 

Get ready to fly away this summer and witness the neverending glow of these 7 wonderful international destinations in May. Read below and find out which is your ideal place to visit.

### Why Travel Internationally in May Month?

Traveling internationally in May is advantageous because of the seasonality of air travel. Instead of the traditional Summer, Winter, Spring, and Rainy seasons, air travel, especially ticket fares are decided on High Season, Low Season, and Shoulder Season.

May falls within the Shoulder season which is mid-April to mid-June. That’s why ticket fares are reduced for major destinations and crowds are also minimal around these months. So, travel internationally in May as:

* You will find comparatively cheaper airfares.
* You can enjoy the pleasant and warm weather.

While Summer is trying to put its roots in the atmosphere, May becomes a month where you can discover affordable airfares for many international destinations. Take flights to Japan at low fares or travel to any other famous location during May and you will have an amazing travel experience.

### Exciting International Destinations to Marvel In May

May can offer you wonderful sights within your budget, even internationally. So, if you are ready to cross the oceans and explore this beautiful world, here are some places you’d love to be. Let’s have a look!

#### 1. Japan

Do Cherry Blossoms Captivate You?

**Visit Japan, then!**

Imagine strolling under a canopy of cherry blossoms in Japan. Sounds interesting, right? Well, May is the season for cherry blossoms in this beautiful land. If you book before April and fly there for the golden week, you’ll be awe-struck for sure. Japan is one of the best international locations in the world, and traveling there in May will feel like every little piece of land is celebrating your vacation with you.

#### Some Popular Cities in Japan

* Tokyo
* Kyoto
* Osaka
* Yokohama
* Nagoya
* Nara
* Sapporo

#### 2. Italy

Is Pasta, Pizza, or Gelato music to your ears?

**Then, Italy is for you!**

Okay, the land where pasta originally came from is a go-to for an international vacation when you can not resist eating pasta. With mild weather and fewer crowds in May, Italy will bring you enough opportunities to twirl the pasta. You can enjoy the outdoor activities in the Italian countryside or attend some food festivals around the cities for authentic Pizza or Gelato, whichever you prefer.

#### Some Popular Cities in Italy

* Rome
* Milan
* Venice
* Florence
* Naples
* Bologna
* Siena
* Lucca
* Genoa

#### 3. Greece

Are you into the Greek Mythology?

**Go to Greece!**

If you have been reading about the ancient Greek gods all your life and their controversial stories attract you, visit Greece. May month offers its warmth in Greece, mixing the pleasant scent of Olive trees into the air. You can bask in the sun by the shimmering Aegean Sea and sip on Ouzo (a clear-colored liqueur made from grape). Or, you can explore the beautiful landscapes around the country and take an everlasting picture in your mind.

#### Some Popular Cities in Greece

* Athens
* Santorini
* Thessaloniki
* Piraeus
* Chania
* Kalambaka
* Rhodes Town
* Corfu Town

#### 4. Peru

Always up for Adrenaline Rush?

**Try exploring Peru!**

If you are feeling adventurous, then Peru is calling for you. A place with so many ancient wonders, Peru can be your playground for the best international escapes. The dry season kicks off in May, and you can hike the Inca trail or join a trekking adventure to let the adrenaline flow into your veins. Besides, Peru is also home to some ancient ruins that showcase the older and glorious side of the country.

#### Some Popular Cities in Peru

* Lima
* Cusco
* Arequipa
* Trujillo
* Chiclayo

#### 5. United Kingdom

Want to Witness The Roaylty Still Alive?

**Travel to the United Kingdom**

The United Kingdom is a place where the legacy of the kings and queens still lives on in every glided detail. May offers the perfect opportunity to explore the royal wonders of the UK. If you are in luck, you can even catch a glimpse of his majesty himself while you are on your way to witness the regal history. This year, plan a visit to the country where you can feel the touch of grandeur and step into a world where the royalty spirit still reigns supreme.

#### Some Popular Cities in The United Kingdom

* London
* Edinburgh
* Liverpool
* Bristol
* Oxford
* Manchester
* Glasgow
* York
* Birmingham
* Southampton
* Beverly
* Nottingham

Many airlines do have certain rules and regulations that help them to maintain the principles of happy passengers. Passengers should always follow the rules and guidelines set by the airline. Failure to do so may result in being denied boarding or a fine. It is important to be respectful and understanding to other passengers and follow all instructions given by the flight crew. In case you fail to follow the restrictions imposed by your respective airline, you may lose booking value. And you may get frustrated as, in some cases, the airline may block you from using its services in the future.

## Things to Remember on a Flight

Airlines typically have so many restrictions to ensure the safety and well-being of all the passengers. So, when flying, you not only need tips for booking flight tickets online but also have to be mindful of your behavior throughout the journey.

### Dos and Don’ts on Planes

When you board the plane, never leave your luggage unattended, never use your phone during takeoff or landing, and never attempt to open an emergency exit door. Always keep your belongings close to you, and follow all safety instructions given by the crew team. You should never attempt to move about the plane while the seat belt sign is still on, and remaining seated until the seatbelt sign is turned off are some essential things you must consider while flying to your destination. Continue to have more information on things you should never do on a plane:

* #### Silence is the key to a better-flying experience

Passengers and airlines love a peaceful environment. Do not make any unnecessary noise on the plane that causes disturbance. If you willingly or unwillingly make noise that distracts other passengers, you might get yourself in trouble. Some airlines ask passengers to maintain silence, as it is difficult for the pilot to be focused during the flight operation, which may result in turbulence.

* #### Use Shoes during the Journey

While walking or sitting in your seat, always try to wear shoes. Never take them off, as getting contaminated may be dangerous for you and your co-passenger. Your body composition may differ, and due to bad odor, your co-passenger may feel uneasy, so, as a caution, never leave your shoes out from your feet.

* #### Never say hello to smoking

Many airlines have banned smoking cigarettes to protect the operational structure of the plane and help passengers enjoy the flight journey to the fullest. In addition to cigarettes, you may not be allowed to use vapes and e-cigarettes in the aircraft. If the flight attendant notices you are not obeying the rule set by the airline, then you might get banned from flying for a specific period. In short, no [Airline ticket Bookings ](https://www.nowtobook.com/airlines)allowed for a while!

* #### Never be intoxicated before or during your flight journey

Most airlines ask their passengers not to drink before or during their flight journey. You should also be aware of the regulations regarding [alcohol consumption](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alcohol_and_health). Alcohol consumption may be limited to a certain amount, and passengers are not allowed to get drunk on board. It is also important to be aware of the dress code.

* #### Don’t Open the Gate in the Mid-way

You need to prioritize your and your co-passenger safety by applying the guidelines informed by the flight attendant. You should never try to open the gate mid-way; it creates a hazardous situation, and you might risk the safety of your and your loved ones' lives. This is recorded specially for passengers owing an exit gate seat.

* #### Never argue with Flight attendants

Flight attendants are your first companions during your flight journey. They take care of everything and try their best to offer you the best available service. Arguing with them is not good as they need to attend to you and other passengers. They strive to elevate your experience, so, helping them is a must to enjoy a more peaceful and pleasurable flight journey.

* #### Don’t misuse the call button

The call button is placed above all seats to help passengers in an emergency or whenever they need in-person assistance. Misusing this feature will create annoyance, and your journey may be affected. We request you to use the call button service as per your requirement and only if needed. Please be patient while waiting for a response, and do not press it repeatedly. Respect the privacy of other passengers around you; it will help you get the best service without further hustle.

* #### Use your seat recline facility within the limit

Why would you think to disturb others? Be a perfect co-passenger and recline your seat up to the designated angle. Don’t push hard, and maintain the decorum. You should keep your seatbelt buckled at all times to ensure the safety of everyone on board. Respect other passengers' personal space. Turn off your phone and other devices while the plane is taking off and landing. Be a responsible traveler.

### Creating a Harmonious Flight Environment!

When you respect the comfort and privacy of others, your travel experience will be more pleasurable. Some limitations imposed by the airline are meant to make your journey more enjoyable and elegant. Follow the airline's policies and be respectful to the crew members. Assist other passengers in need, be a pleasant passenger, and gain appreciation for your good deeds. If you want detailed tips on being on your best behavior, take charge to connect with the [Nowtobook](https://www.nowtobook.com/) expert team. We can not only help you book cheap tickets but also give you tips and tricks to get through your journey in harmony.

### Airline Carry-on Luggage Size Restrictions: What You Need to Know

Are you planning a weekend getaway? Or just want to travel with a major airline for business? Regardless, you must understand how much luggage you can bring with you. Most airlines have luggage size and weight restrictions for customers as well as a fee applies when you check bags into the airline’s luggage compartment. However, carry-on luggage is mostly free which you can take along in the aircraft cabin. But do airlines also impose carry-on luggage restrictions? 

Well, the answer is yes, airlines' carry-on luggage restrictions are imposed to make sure each passenger can carry bags along for their convenience. These also help you place the bags easily in the airplane cabin. Here in this blog, we explain the details of how airlines impose carry-on restrictions and why. Let’s dive straight into the details.

### Why Airlines Have Carry-on Restrictions?

The airlines enforce the carry-on weight and size restrictions for the safety and convenience of the passengers, There is limited space in the overhead bins of aircraft cabins. However, they are meant to accommodate all passengers’ bags, and oversized luggage makes it difficult to place the bags, creating a safety hazard.

They make sure in-cabin bags are not too big or heavy to make sure there are no threats during turbulence or emergency evacuations. Besides, uniform size and weight restrictions help airlines streamline their boarding process, which reduces delays.

### Do Airlines Allow To Bring Carry-on Bags For Free?

Yes, several airlines allow you to carry one small bag and a personal item free of charge into the cabin. This is possible with even the most restricted fare type with the airlines, where you do not have a free checked baggage allowance or other flexibilities. Some airlines with free carry-on baggage allowance include;

* Southwest Airlines
* Delta Air Lines
* American Airlines
* United Airlines
* Alaska Airlines
* JetBlue Airways
* Lufthansa
* Air France
* Emirates
* Qatar Airways
* Singapore Airlines

Some airlines that would enable free personal items but not carry-on in their basic fare are:

* Frontier airlines
* Spirit Airlines
* Allegiant Air

#### Few Airlines That Charge For Carry-on

* Ryanair
* EasyJet
* Wizz Air
* Vueling
* Norwegian Air Shuttle

Always check the specific airline's policy before you travel, as carry-on allowances can vary by fare type and destination. For example, if you book Delta Airlines tickets at low fares, you can enjoy free carry-on and personal items along with the bookings.

### What Are The Standard Dimensions For Carry-on Bags?

Most airlines have similar carry-on luggage dimensions for their customers. The number of bags may vary depending on your fare type and airline, but the dimensions for carry-on luggage remain the same. Here are the average dimensions:

* 22 inches (56 cm) in height: Measured from the bottom to the top of the bag.
* 14 inches (36 cm) in width: Measured from side to side.
* 9 inches (23 cm) in depth: Measured from front to back.

These dimensions are calculated, including the wheels and handles of the bags. This size is determined to fit the overhead compartments on most aircraft seats. The actual dimensional details may vary by the airline. Review your airline’s baggage policy in detail to understand that.

#### Some examples from the airlines are:

* Southwest Airlines: 10 x 16 x 24 inches (25 x 40 x 61 cm)
* Delta Air Lines: 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm)
* American Airlines: 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm)
* United Airlines: 9 x 14 x 22 inches (23 x 36 x 56 cm)
* JetBlue Airways: 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm)
* Alaska Airlines: 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm)
* Lufthansa: 22 x 14 x 9 inches (55 x 40 x 23 cm)
* Air France: 21.7 x 13.8 x 9.8 inches (55 x 35 x 25 cm)
* Emirates: 22 x 14 x 9 inches (55 x 38 x 20 cm)
* Qatar Airways: 22 x 15 x 8 inches (56 x 38 x 20 cm)

#### Popular Carry-on Bag Types

* Spinner Wheels
* Two-Wheeled Rollers
* Duffel Bags
* Tote Bags
* Hardside Luggage
* Softside Luggage
* Backpacks

### What Are The Size Restrictions for Personal Items?

You can also carry a personal item along with you in addition to your carry-on bag into the aircraft cabins, The standard size allowance for a personal item is somewhat around 18 X 14 X 8 inches. This can vary depending on your airline. For example, you may get slightly different dimensions for personal items on[ booking Southwest Airlines flights](https://www.nowtobook.com/airlines/southwest) whereas a bit more or less for Air Canada. Check with your airline beforehand and only then pack your bags.

#### Types of Allowed Personal Items

* Backpacks
* Tote Bags
* Handbags
* Messenger Bags
* Diaper Bags
* Laptop Bags
* Travel Organizers
* Small Duffel Bags
* Camera Bags
* Baby Strollers
* Pet Carriers

### General Rules for Carry-on Luggage By Airlines

* Most airlines allow one carry-on bag and one personal item (e.g., a handbag, laptop bag, or small backpack).
* Some airline may allow two or three bags to carry along for business or similar higher class passengers.
* Your Pet container will count towards the carry-on bag when traveling with pets, and you will only be allowed to carry one personal item in this case. The same applies to baby strollers,
* The carry-on and personal items dimensions also include handles and wheels.
* The bag must fit in the overhead bin, and the personal item should fit under the front seat.
* Additional charges may apply if you bring overweight or oversized items.

### Quick Tips To Comply with Carry-on Restrictions

You must understand and adhere to the airline's carry-on weight and size restrictions to make sure you have a hassle-free journey. Even if you booked tickets using the cheapest fare tools likeCondor Airlines low fare calendar, the same rules will apply. Here’s how you can comply with them and avoid any extra charges:

* Use measuring tape to ensure your bag meets the airline’s size requirements, including wheels and handles. Even a slight overage could result in your bag being checked at the gate.
* Use a portable luggage scale to weigh your bag if your airline has weight restrictions. It’s better to be prepared than surprised at the gate.
* Opt for soft-sided luggage, which is more flexible and easier to fit into tight spaces in overhead bins.
* Expandable bags can lead to size issues if overpacked. Make sure your bag still fits within the airline's size limits when expanded.
* Roll your clothes instead of folding them to save space and help avoid wrinkles.
* Use packing cubes to organize your items and maximize space.
* Remember the TSA’s 3-1-1 rule for liquids in your carry-on. All liquids must be in containers of 3.4 ounces (100 ml) or less, packed in a quart-sized bag.
* Always check the specific airline’s website for the most up-to-date carry-on policies before you start packing. Airlines occasionally update their size and weight restrictions, and what was acceptable on your last flight might not be this time.

### What Happens if Your Carry-on is Oversized?

Three situations happen when you have oversized carry-on bags. It is discovered at check-in, at the gate, or during boarding. Here are the details:

#### 1. At Check-in

If your bag is flagged as oversized or overweight at the check-in counter, the airline may require you to check the bag, which often involves additional fees. Depending on the airline and your destination, these fees can range from $30 to $100 or more.

#### 2. At the Gate

Sometimes, an oversized carry-on might only be detected at the gate. In such cases, you’ll likely need to[ gate-check your bag](https://www.travelandleisure.com/airlines-airports/airport-gate-check-carry-on-bag), which means it will be placed in the cargo hold with the checked luggage. While this usually doesn’t incur a fee, it does mean you’ll have to wait at baggage claim to retrieve your bag after the flight.

#### 3. During Boarding

If the overhead bins are full or your bag is too large to fit, flight attendants may ask you to check your carry-on at the gate. This can be inconvenient, especially if you have a tight connection, as you won’t have access to your bag during layovers.

Connect with [Nowtobook](https://www.nowtobook.com/)to understand the ins and outs of baggage policy and the airline’s restrictions if your bag is more than the allowed limits.

### Carry-on vs. Personal Item: What’s the Difference?

You may understand the exact difference between carry-on bags and a personal item to maximize your packing space and avoid any additional fees. Here are the key differences between the two items:

|                          |                                                                                           |                                                                                      |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Aspect**               | **Carry-On Bag**                                                                          | **Personal Item**                                                                    |
| **Definition**           | A larger piece of luggage that fits in the overhead bin.                                  | A smaller bag that fits under the seat in front of you.                              |
| **Examples**             | Small suitcases, duffel bags, larger backpacks.                                           | Purses, laptop bags, small backpacks, and briefcases.                                |
| **Size Restrictions**    | Typically up to 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm), though it may vary.                 | Generally around 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).                               |
| **Purpose**              | Ideal for packing the majority of your travel essentials, such as clothes and toiletries. | Designed for items you need easy access to, like passports, phones, and medications. |
| **Access During Flight** | Not needed during the flight; stored in the overhead bin.                                 | Accessible during the flight; stored under the seat in front.                        |

#### Conclusion

That’s all about the airline’s carry-on weight and size restrictions. If you have more questions, feel free to connect with the Nowtobook team to learn how you can maximize your space on the plane. Our team may even help you with the booking procedures and managing your bookings.

## Major US Airlines That Use Boeing Aircraft

Boeing’s commercial airplanes have been around in the aviation industry for decades. You will see Boeing planes crisscrossing the globe every day for both domestic and international flights. Whenever you schedule air travel there’s a good chance that your plane was built by Boeing.

Despite facing a huge backlash recently, Boeing remains an industry giant with its planes dominating the skies. But which airlines continue to use Boeing jets for their operations? Major US airlines top the charts when listing airlines using Boeing aircrafts.
Let’s explore a list of airlines that still trust Boeing to get their passengers from Point A to Point B through the high skies. 

### 5 Airlines That Still Operate Boeing Aircrafts

Many major airline fleets around the world use Boeing airplanes. Although the company has had a troublesome few years due to two fatal crashes in a row, we cannot forget that thousands of Boeing aircraft successfully transport passengers to and from different destinations across the world daily. 

Ch-aviation Data shows that currently, almost 10,000 Boeing commercial Jetliners are in service around the world. Some of the largest US airline planes are built by Boeing as we already discussed before. Here are the names of 5 such airlines and their aircraft details:

#### 1. American Airlines

American Airlines (AA) has one of the largest Boeing Fleets in the world. This year, the airline has over 300 Boeing 737 aircraft. For its international routes, AA relies on Boeing 777s, especially for long-haul routes. 

The airline is even the largest operator of the Boeing 737-800, which is a major part of American Airline's domestic fleet. The airline also invested in the Boeing 787 Dreamliner due to its high fuel efficiency and advanced technology. In addition to Boeing, AA has Airbus A320 family aircraft in its fleet. However the count of Boeing planes is somewhat around 450+.

#### 2. United Airlines

Another major operator of Boeing aircraft is United Airlines. It has a diverse fleet that includes Boeing 737, 757, 767, 777, and 787. Over 350 Boeing 737s handle most domestic flights, while 50 Boeing 787 Dreamliners rule the long-haul international routes. The airline flies everything from 767-300ER to 737 MAX 9. The airline is not an all Boeing customer, but it still relies mostly on their commercial Jetliners for a number of independent routes and destinations.

#### 3. Southwest Airlines

Southwest is the only airline with all Boeing aircraft in its fleet, exceeding 700 aircraft. This low-cost airline is the largest 737 operator in the world and has been a loyal customer for more than 50 years. The airline’s commitment to 737s is obvious in its recent order for 737 MAXs. The airline currently flies 737-800s, 700s, and 737 MAX 8. The airline is majorly connected to the 737 MAX programs regardless of its setbacks. The airline ordered 349 new MAXs and has received 66 so far, and it aims to add another 270 of the same to its fleet through 2031.

#### 4. Alaska Airlines

Alaska Airlines also operates many Boeing planes. The fleet includes various models of Boeing aircraft with a firm presence in the Pacific Northwest. Its fleet mainly consists of [Boeing 737ws](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boeing_737) from which- 61 are 737-800s, 32 are 737-900ER, 13 MAX 9s, The airline has majorly focusted on passenger comfort and fuel efficiency. Its young operational fleet is an example of effortless flying services in the aviation industry.

5\. Delta Airlines

Delta Airlines also operates several Boeing-built planes. Although it has shifted to Airbus A320s for most of its operations, it still has a large fleet of Boeing aircraft. The airline has widely embraced the Airnbus aircrafts but it still has many of the old planes from Boeing which include-Boeing 737, 757, 717, 767, 777, 737 MAX. 

### Other Notable International Airlines Using Boeing

Many other major air carriers in the world continue to rely on Boeing aircraft for their operations. These include:

* #### Emirates

This airline is majorly known for its luxurious service on long-haul flights. You will find many Boeing planes of Emirates within the UAE to U SA route.

* #### Ryanair

The European carrier also uses many Boeing aircraft in its fleets for their efficiency and longstanding in the aviation industry.

* #### Lufthansa

This German carrier includes a mixed fleet with Boeing 747s and 777s. Some of these are a key part of its long-haul fleet.

* #### British Airways

The UK’s flag carrier, British Airways, also operates Boeing 777s and 787s for its long-haul services. It is also a significant operator of Boeing 747s

* #### Japan Airlines (JAL)

JAL operates a fleet of Boeing 767s, 777s, and 787s for both domestic and international services. The 787 Dreamliner from Boeing is the major player in its fleet

### Are Boeing Airplanes Safe?

The safety of Boeing airplanes concerns many travelers givem the few incidents from the past. But are they really safe or not? Let’s figure this out with the following information:

#### Incident 1- Boeing 737 MAX 9

Recently one of the Boeing’s 737 MAX 9 jetluners resumed carrying travelers in the USA after being grounded for safety concerns. Alaska Airlines and United Airlines are the only two carriers in the United States with this particular model.

The grounding occured after a panel called door plug broke loose on [Alaska Airlines flights](https://www.nowtobook/airlines/alaska). The FAA detailed a new inspection process for these door plugs. Mike Whitaker the administrator of FAA assured that as long as airlines follow this process, the planes will be safe.

#### Incident 2- Boeing 737-900

United Airlines flight on a Boeing 737-900 had to make an emergency landing after engine flames. This was a rare event, but it concerned the safety of the traveling passengers. During this incident, the airline responded swiftly and ensured passengers safety and no casualties were reported. But the FAA took action and inspected the incident to make sure this never occurs again.

Despite these dramatic incidents making news headlines and bombarding social media, air travel remains extremely safe with Boeing. Although the trust in Boeing jetliners and other commercial planes was shaken, as long as the airlines continue to adhere to the safety procedures, there won’t be an issue.

### Pro-Tip- How To Check Which Plane You Will Be Flying? 

If you are concerned about which plane you will be flying, worry not. Just take some time out of your busy schedule to follow one of these methods and check whether your new flight will be a Boeing, Airbus, or another:

* Use the Airline’s official website or mobile app to get detailed information under the manage booking or My Trips section.
* You can also check the same in your flight booking confirmation email. This will mention your aircraft type.
* If you are curious, use flight tracking websites to search your flight and understand the aircraft type. FlightAware, FlightRadar24, and FlightStats are some sites you can use.
* Once at the airport. Check the departure boards to see the aircraft type mentioned alongside the flight information.
* You can also ask the flight crew once you are aboard the plane after making a friendly conversation to share about the aircraft with you.

Most airlines have proper safety and security measures for all their aircraft.So, fly with Boeing worry-free for a safe and comfortable experience. Choose the airline you wish to fly with and take a flight to experience the safest journey aboard a Boeing 737 or 787 Dreamliner. For more details, connect with [Nowtobook](https://www.nowtobook.com/). Our team will be happy to assist you with any information you may need about the aircraft you will be flying on.

**3. Blankets & Pillows**

## 12 Tips On How to Avoid Airline Baggage Fees

We always hunt cheap flight deals, but flying is not as affordable as we think it is. Although we get inexpensive plane tickets from low-cost airlines, the checked baggage and, sometimes, carry-on luggage fees again increase our total spends. Most low-cost carriers impose hefty charges for additional services like baggage, seat selection, and what not! 

Airlines like American, Jetblue, and Alaska have hiked their bag prices this year, and it will be no surprise that other US carriers will soon catch up. Many passengers rely on checked bags, which help them bring a larger container and pack certain necessities. But what about the hefty fee imposed on checking bags?

At times, we exceed the allowed baggage limits, which also increases the total fare by adding an excess baggage charge to our itinerary. In any case, you pay more than you wish to when luggage is included. To help you prevent that, we have mentioned several ways to avoid paying airline baggage fees and save money on your next air travel.

Read this post to the end and learn about ways to save money on luggage.

### 1. Check Whether A Baggage Fee Applies Or Not

Before you book flights in a particular airline cabin, make sure to check whether your fare terms allow baggage for free or if there is an additional fee. If you do proper research on baggage fees, you can ensure that you pay for what you already know and there are no hidden surprises at the airport bag check.

### 2. Pack Smart and Light

Always pack light for air travel. The lighter your bags are, the lower the chances of paying extra fees. Many airlines allow you to carry a limited amount of bags free of cost. So, make sure you pack accordingly lighter and save your money.

### 3. Follow the Weight and Size Guidelines

Most airlines have weight and size restrictions on luggage. You can follow these instructions and avoid paying excess baggage fees when at the airport. Some airlines, like [Delta](https://www.delta.com/), American, and United, limit carry-on bags to 22\* 14\* 9 inches and a maximum weight of 10 kg. If you make sure your bags are of the same weight and size, you don’t need to pay any excess fee unless specified otherwise.

### 4. Save Money with Loyalty Programs

The airline loyalty programs not only let you save on flights, but also offer you to save on baggage fees. Most airlines reward their loyal customers with elite status on their frequent flyer program with free checked baggage allowances.

### 5. Only Take Personal Items on Short-Distance Flights\\

Airlines may charge you a baggage fee for taking carry-on bags with short-haul flight tickets, but they allow small personal items like purses and laptop bags free of cost. If you have a round trip without a stay at your destination, you can avoid bringing anything else than a small purse and avoid paying the luggage cost.

### 6. Use an Airline’s co-branded credit card for Booking

Some credit cards co-branded with an airline, like AMEX cards and other airlines offer free checked baggage to customers along with carry-on. You can book and pay for your flights with these cards and avoid paying any extra fees.

### 7. Use a Travel Backpack for Luggage Packing

Most airlines accept travel backpacks as carry-on luggage, and luckily, many do not charge a fee for hand luggage. In short, you can bring only carry-on luggage on flights with airlines that offer it free of charge. This way, you can avoid paying any fee for luggage and enjoy extra benefits.

### 8. Book a Higher Cabin with Free Add-ons

If you do not worry too much about fares extending, as well as value luxury, then try booking First or Business Class flights over Economy cabins of airlines. These cabins allow you to bring bags free of cost. This way, you won’t have to pay anything, as bags fly free on higher cabin classes.

### 9. Military Bags Fly Free

Airlines always let military persons ease out on baggage as they can bring 3-5 bags with them for free. Some air carriers even permit their immediate family members to bring the same amount of bags without costing anything. So, you can benefit from this if you or someone from your direct family works for the military(free bags offer is mainly available in the USA).

### 10. Check Bags at the Gate

If you have a small rolling bag or related one that you wish to check as a preference, you can do it at the gate instead of the airline’s check-in counter. When the flight is relatively full, airline employees may offer you free gate-checked bag service. As a result, you can save money on baggage.

### 11. Don’t Book Basic Economy Tickets

If you really wish to save on luggage and avoid any charges, you must avoid booking basic economy fare. With these fares, you book [cheap air tickets at lowest price](https://www.nowtobook.com/)**, **but they offer the least allowance for baggage or none at all. Instead, you can try a premium cabin, as we already mentioned, and save on extra bag fees. 

### 12. Distribute the Number of Bags Among Passengers

If you are flying with a group of people and each person has a baggage allowance, you must distribute the bags evenly to avoid paying fees. Suppose you have three bags with you, and someone else in the group is flying with no bags at all or less than their allowed limit. You can check your extra bag under their name and avoid paying an excess baggage fee for yours.

There is only one Black Friday in 2025, falling on November 28, 2025. It’s followed by Cyber Monday on December 1, though many airlines begin sales as early as Thanksgiving week.

## **Airlines Serving the World’s Best In-Flight Food- 15 Amazing Carriers**

Are you planning a long-haul flight and worried about food options? In-flight food may not be the best choice to satiate your hunger on board, but some airlines make it better. Several airlines still serve food to pamper your palate in the skies.

From sustainable food options to healthy diet plans, airlines have embraced the needs of modern passengers. Their hunger pangs are satiated through flavorful options. Besides, every year airlines are advancing more and more on food and drinks menus.

If you are looking for an airline with high-quality food options, we can give you insights into 15 such airlines that have the best in-flight food and meals. Read below to understand which airline is your best choice for uncompromised food.

### **Top 15 Airlines With The Best In-Flight Meals**

Airplane meals may not be the first thing you may be curious about when starting your vacation plans, but they sure are important. Many airlines have upscaled their culinary experiences, even for economy passengers. Here are the 15 airlines with the best in-flight food.

#### **1. Emirates Airways**

**![Emirates Airways](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123109.webp)**

Emirates Airlines has been known for its luxurious cabins and excellent in-flight dining options for more than a decade now. The airline has long stood out of the crowd because of its culinary masters. The airline now ranks one based on many readers because of its innovation in traditional flavors. The airline is committed to global cuisine, offering everything from vegan dishes to delicious non-vegetarian options. Emirates economy-class dining and other inflight dining options exceed expectations. Here is a sample airline menu you may find:

* Light Bites like sandwiches in Economy.
* Fresh seasopnal fruits
* Fruit Yoghurt
* Scrambled eggs with turkey rashers
* Vegetable crepes
* Bread
* Emirates Pizza
* Barley Salad
* Grilled Chicken
* Vegetable Paella
* Apple Caramel Mousse
* Selection of tea, coffee, and juices
* Gluten-free snacks
* Low-lactose meals

#### **2. Turkish Airlines**

**![Turkish Airlines](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123132.webp)**

The second in the list of best in-flight food and drink options is Turkish Airlines. This Turkey-based airline serves amazing food in a generous quantity. The airline focuses on seasonality while keeping things fresh for an absolute sumptuous dining. There are select flights where flying chefs prepare meals that go beyond the normal taste palates. The sample food menu on Turkish Airlines may include:

* Adana Kebab
* Sesame Pita Bread or Sourdough Sandwich
* Potato Frocaccia rolls
* Hot & Cold beverages
* Special Meals
* Trabzone Bread
* Homemade cocktails
* Girite ezme
* Chicken Cutlets
* Feta Cheese and other ingredients.

Remember that some of the food options are limited to business class only, and others may also be available in Economy. Make sure to check your cabin details before booking a **Turkish Airlines flight ticket**.

#### **3. Singapore Airlines**

**![Singapore Airlines](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123145.webp)**

When dining at 30,000+ feet above sea level, Singapore Airlines is your ideal partner. The airline understands that cabin pressure can alter taste perceptions in passengers. Therefore, the airline’s culinary team tests everything in a simulated environment before providing you with their best creations. The best part about Singapore Airlines airplane food is that they offer a “Book a Cook” option for premium cabin customers who can select and pre-order dishes to try onboard. Here is a sample menu of the airline:

* Value Meals
* Baby Meal
* Child Meal for Infants
* Child Meal Asian
* Congee with pork ball
* Century Egg
* Mee Siam
* Laksa
* Braised Beef and Mushroom Ragout
* Mashed Potato
* Fried Chicken
* Slow-cooked fillet Barramundi
* Warm waffle with strawberry coulis
* Religious meals
* Hindu Non-vegetarian meals

#### **4. All Nippon Airways (ANA)**

**![All Nippon Airways](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123217.webp)**

ANA is another airline with amazing food service, especially for first-class and business-class customers. If you are flying this Japanese airline, you can enjoy quality meals with amazing taste. See online reviews for the ANA Airlines food scene, and there will be several praises. Take a look at their basic menu, which includes:

* Goat Cheese with Crushed Pistachio
* Smoked Salmon and Scallop Tartare
* Champagne
* Japanese authentic meals
* Western food menus

#### **5. Lufthansa Airlines**

![Lufthansa Airlines](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123728.jpg)

This German carrier is not behind in serving the best in-flight food, among others. This global airline serves amazing food onboard, especially to first and business-class customers. These fare cabins serve German favorites and some international flavors. From appetizers to tasty main courses, this airline serves delectable food for all the customers. The airline’s sample food menu varies based on the class you booked and may include the following:

* Hokkaido Pumpkin with crème fraîche
* Lemon Or Lamb’s lettuce with golden raisins, feta and pine nuts
* Ropasted Niederscahsenm Pike-Perch with Beluga Lentils, red cabbage chips
* Small Chocolate and water bottles for free on Economy
* Pre-order more onboard delights
* Salads & Sandwiches
* Pretzels and Chips
* A piece of cake and coffee.

Remember, not every list on the menu will be free. Some things that taste better cost too much. So, try to get something at the airport or avoid food if it's a short-haul flight booking with Lufthansa Airlines

#### **6. Cathay Pacific**

**![Cathay Pacific](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123747.webp)**

This airline is fully fledged embracing sustainable luxury and focuses on food that represents wellness and health. You can find several delights 0nboard a Cathay Pacific flight including freshly brewed coffee or a betsy. For first-class passengers, there is sustainable caviar that they serve on elegant spoons. So, in simple words, the food scene on Cathay Pacific will surely up to your exquisite taste and sophisticated palate.

#### **7. Qatar Airways**

**![Qatar Airways](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123759.webp)**

It was at the top of the food scene for many consecutive years, which has now dropped, but it is still a top pick for many reasons. You can feast as per your schedule with Qatar Airways. The airline offers its a la carte menu on demand in first and business class. Besides, many delicacies on the menu include:

* Amuse Bouche
* Appetizers
* Soups
* Sous Vide Lobster Tail
* Cheese Platter
* Hazelnut and brown butter tart
* Burrata Salad with heirloom tomato
* Special dietary meals

#### **8. Air France**

**![Air France](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123813.webp)**

The French are very serious about their cuisine, and so is Air France. The airline makes sure that each flight is a gastronomic delight. The airline has collaborated with the top-class chefs of France to provide sumptuous meals to all the passengers. Air France’s La Premiere and Business class offers meals from culinary starters Anne-Sophie Pic and Arnaud Lallement on long-haul routes. Their fresh, local, and season’s best ingredients are served to every passenger in eco-friendly packaging.

#### **9. Etihad Airways**

**![Etihad Airways](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123827.webp)**

This airline redefines the in-flight dining scene with its farm-to-tray food options. The airline has partnered with UAE’s regional farmers and other farms in its serving regions to provide you with ultimate fresh and locally grown food. Their A la carte menu can be perfect to satiate your hunger at any time of the day during your flight. They are another definition of luxury already, and their food options make it icing on the cake. The Etihad Airways food menu includes:

* Complimentary meals
* Vegetarian options
* Freshly baked rolls
* Indulgent desserts

#### **10. Korean Air**

**![Korean Air](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123839.webp)**

This amazing South Korean airline has special and seasoned dishes that are a Korean specialty with a dash of familiar local tastes for international customers. You can dine on seasonal flavors with specially sourced ingredients with the essence of your destination. The airline never compromises on flavor and quality with its in-flight food menu containing:

* Bibimbap
* Braised Mackerel
* Wines
* Gochujang
* Cup Ramen
* Bulgogi rice
* Tteokbokki

#### **11. Japan Airlines**

**![Japan Airlines](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123851.webp)**

Japan Airlines serves the best food in economy than any other airline in business. The airline’s popular routes to the States have special meals and more dietary options for a perfect experience. Besides, they elegantly serve food, making dining even more fun. You can enjoy potato salad with sakura petals. Sakura shrimp and mustard blossoms. There are also Western meal choices for a more familiar taste onboard.

#### **12. Hawaiian Airlines**

**![Hawaiian Airlines](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123907.webp)**

If you think of domestic American Airlines with above-average meal service, Hawaiian Airlines is not far behind in the list. The airline continues to offer a hot meal to every single guest regardless of their ticket class. That is one of the major reasons why its in-flight food and drinks menu is one of the best of all. The airline serves the following items to customers:

* Choice of Cocktail
* Dessert
* Main course
* Hawaiian authentic dishes
* Chicken Schnitzel
* Braised Red Cabbage
* Warm Red Potato salad.

#### **13. Delta Airlines**

**![Delta Airlines](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123918.webp)**

Up until last year, Delta was not on this list. But this year, everything has changed. The airline has upped its in-flight dining in a big change. The airline now offers cozy tea, special food, and even BBQ meals in its first class. Delta also has some great desserts for premium passengers.

#### **14. Air New Zealand**

**![Air New Zealand](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123932.webp)**

This airline brings in enough flavor with its choices of meals. There are Asian and Mediterranean ingredients that are used to make several dishes. The airline even has a quick bite to serve customers on night-time flights. Choose to fly with them and we bet you will enjoy the best in-flight food menu on Air New Zealand.

#### **15. Virgin Atlantic**

**![Virgin Atlantic](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/19092024123947.webp)**

Although Virgin America has closed operations, Virgin Atlantic is still operating routes with the UK and the US, Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean. Their upper-class food menu is one of the best in the industry. They also have special appetizers and an excellent main dish. You can even enjoy chicken and vegan meals in the main courses depending on your choice.

With these 15 airlines, even Economy-Class passengers can get multiple-course meals. From bread and salad to main course and dessert, there is everything your taste buds will love. So, make sure to check out the airfares for one of these airlines for your specific flight routes and connect with [Nowtobook](https://www.nowtobook.com/). We will help you arrange a flight with pre-ordered food so you can get through the long hours of travel without feeling hungry or exhausted.

London is an incredible destination in England with iconic attractions inside the city. But did you know that some of the most exciting adventures lie just beyond the city?

Once you cross this bustling cosmopolitan city, you will find more fascinating places that are even better than the locations inside London. We have gathered the scoop on several tourist places to explore near London, where you can go for a day trip or more.

These fabulous tourist attractions are majestic and offer a blend of everything from royal charm to rich history and a serene atmosphere. If you want to explore London as a whole, a visit to these 12 tourist attractions is a must. Let’s find out about each option in detail.

## **Top 12 Tourist Spots to Visit Nearby London**

As you get ready to explore London and its surrounding destinations, you can never miss out on a few places. A visit to the best places nearby can help enhance your experience to the maximum and offer you a great way to experience vacationing in London. Let's take a dive into the details of these 12 destinations and how to experience the best day trips from London nearby:

* Windsor
* Oxford
* Bath
* Brighton
* Cambridge
* Stonehenge
* The Cotswolds
* Hampton Court Palace
* Canterbury
* Leeds Castle
* Seven Sisters Cliffs
* Warwick Castle

### **1. Windsor Castle**

![Windsor Castle](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070345.webp)

_**Location: 24 miles west of London**_

_**Distance: 45 minutes by train**_

Windsor Castle’s history goes long back to the 11th century. It is one of the oldest castles in the world. It displays a regal vibe and has a royal history in the British region. Windsor was once the official residence of the Queen. The magnificent fortress is open to the public all year round. You can get a glimpse into the British monarchy and its history with just one visit an explore this iconic castle on your trip to London.

_**Best Way to Get There: **Take a direct train from Waterloo or London Paddington station_

_**Main attractions**: Windsor Castle, St. George's Chapel, Windsor Great Park_

_**Best time to visit**: Spring and summer to see the castle gardens are in full bloom_

### **2. Oxford City**

**![Oxford City](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070408.webp)**

_**Location**: 56 miles northwest of London_

_**Distance: **1 hour by train_

Oxford is a city 56 miles away from the Big Smoke—London—on the confluence of the River Thames and Cherwell. The city is majorly famous for its prestigious university of the same name. Students from all over the world want to get admission there and study for their higher education. Oxford is also a good place for exciting outdoor activities near London. So, take a trip to the royal capital of England and plan a visit to Oxford.

_**Best way to get there:** Direct trains run from London Paddington or Marylebone_

_**Main attractions: **University of Oxford, Bodleian Library, Radcliffe Camera_

_**Best time to visit:** All year round. However Spring offers the most pleasant weather that helps you explore Oxford on foot. _

### **3. Bath**

**![Bath](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070423.webp)**

_**Location: 115 miles west of London**_

_**Distance: 1.5 hours by train**_

If you are looking for popular tourist places near London, Bath is your next destination. Also, honored to be a UNESCO World Heritage Site, this place is a haven for those looking to relax better. It was first founded by Romans around the first century A.D. Today it has developed to be a fashionable city with so much to enjoy and see. A renowned author, Jane Austen, called it home for a few years, and now it has so many attractions with actual baths as the name of this amazing location.

_**The best way to get there:** a Train ride from London Paddington _

_**Main attractions: **Roman Baths, Bath Abbey, Royal Crescent_

_**Best time to visit:** Spring and autumn, when the weather is mild and the town is less crowded_

### **4. Brighton**

**![Brighton](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070439.webp)**

_**Location**: 54 miles south of London_

_**Distance: ** 1 hour by train_

Do you wish to explore the London Countryside? Book day trips from London and visit Brighton. It is a seaside town with plenty of beaches, fun and cultural experiences, and unique, quirky shops to enjoy some retail therapy on your visit. Book your flights to London today at low fares and enjoy a train ride from there onwards to enjoy Brighton’s major attractions.

_**Best way to get there: **Direct trains from London Victoria and London Bridge_

_**Main attractions**: Brighton Pier, Royal Pavilion, The Lanes_

_**Best time to visit: **Summer for beaches and festivals outdoors_

### **5. Cambridge**

**![Cambridge](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070454.webp)**

_**Location: 60 miles north of London**_

_**Distance: 1 hour by train**_

Cambridge is similar to Oxford- a city famous for its prestigious universities. You can also find some river scenes in the city that add icing to the cake. Cambridge University is a major hub for education and another famous University near London where students just want to be admitted for their better studies. Plan a tour to explore the University in the city or explore River Cam on a day trip. These are in close proximity to London, and here’s some more interesting information if you are planning to visit Cambridge.

_**Best way to get there:** Direct trains from London King’s Cross or Liverpool Street_

_**Main attractions:** King’s College Chapel, The Backs, Cambridge University Botanic Garden_

_**Best time to visit: **Spring and summer _

### **6. Stonehenge**

**![Stonehenge](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070513.webp)**

_**Location: 88 miles southwest of London**_

_**Distance: 2 hours by car or bus**_

A day trip from London seems incomplete without visiting the Bath and Stonehenge. You already know the significance of Bath, but Stonehenge is a better place to see nearby London. You can explore this mysterious stone circle that has been around for centuries and still fascinates visitors in the same way. Plan a visit to this amazing location and have an out-of-the-world experience. Make sure to add this to your list of must-see places near London and enjoy an authentic vibe.

_**Best way to get there: **Trains from London Waterloo to Salisbury, then a local bus_

_**Main attractions: **Stonehenge, Salisbury Cathedral_

_**Best time to visit: **Early morning in summer for fewer crowds and a stunning sunrise_

### **7. The Cotswolds**

**![The Cotswolds](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070529.webp)**

_**Location: 90 miles northwest of London**_

_**Distance: 2 hours by car**_

If you wish to cover a huge area and want the best day trips from London, a visit to the Cotswolds will definitely pay off the efforts. This amazing place is a bang for your buck to visit on your next holiday in London. The area runs through 5 counties: Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire, Warwickshire, Wiltshire, and Worcestershire)

**Best way to get there: **Trains from London Paddington to Moreton-in-Marsh 

**Main attractions: **Cotswold Wildlife Park, Bourton-on-the-Water, Blenheim Palace 

**Best time to visit:** Late spring and early autumn for the best weather and scenery

### **8. Hampton Court Palace**

**![Hampton Court Palace](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024070741.webp)**

_**Location: 12 miles southwest of London**_

_**Distance: 40 minutes by car or train**_

Hampton Court Palace is a magnificent royal residence known for its impressive Tudor and Baroque architecture. Once the home of King Henry VIII, this splendid palace invites visitors to discover its opulent state apartments, expansive kitchens, lovely gardens, and a renowned hedge maze. The palace's deep historical significance, paired with its royal splendor, makes it an essential destination for those who appreciate history and architecture.

_**Best way to get there: **_Direct trains from London Waterloo to Hampton Court Station

_**Main attractions: **_Tudor Kitchens, The Great Hall, Hampton Court Gardens, The Maze

Spring and summer to enjoy the gardens in full bloom and for outdoor events like the Hampton Court Palace Flower Show

#### **9. Arundel Castle**

![Arundel Castle](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024072858.webp)

_**Location: 65 miles southwest of London**_

_**Distance: 1.5 hours by car or train**_

Arundel Castle is a well-preserved medieval castle with a history of almost a thousand years old located in the heartland of West Sussex. It belonged to the Dukes of Norfolk and allows tourists to explore its perfectly maintained interior, stately chambers, and opulent gardens. Standing tall, the castle offers magnificent views of South Downs and River Arun making it the perfect single-day sightseeing for those interested in history as well as nature.

_**Best way to get there: D**irect trains from London Victoria to Arundel Station_

_**Main attractions:** The Keep, Castle Rooms, Fitzalan Chapel, and Arundel Gardens_

_**Best time to visit: S**pring and summer for garden tours and seasonal events at the castle_

### **10. Richmond Park**

![Richmond Park](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024072842.webp)

_**Location: 10 miles southwest of London**_
_**Distance: 45 minutes by car or 30 minutes by train from central London**_

London has many Parks, but Richmond Park near the city is one of the most significant royal parks. This lush green landscape is famous for its sleekness, large woods, and wandering deer. There are several ways to mingle with nature like several trails for hiking and biking and areas for picnicking. The park’s Pembroke Lodge is also a beautiful and serene location with a view of the Thames Valley. Richmond Park is also one of the largest parks in or around London.

_**Best way to get there:** Trains from London Waterloo to Richmond Station, then a short bus or walk to the park_
_**Main attractions:** Isabella Plantation, King Henry's Mound, Richmond Hill, and the free-roaming deer_
_**Best time to visit:** Spring and autumn for beautiful foliage and to see the park’s wildlife in action_

### **11. Seven Sisters Cliffs**

![Seven Sisters Cliffs](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024071443.webp)

_**Location:** About 87 miles south of London_
_**Distance:** Around 2 hours by car or train_

If you're craving fresh sea air and jaw-dropping coastal views, the Seven Sisters Cliffs are the perfect escape. These are towering white chalk cliffs stretched through the coastline of sussex. You can enjoy the stunning scenery of England through these amazing figures that stand tall from god knows when?
Take a refreshing break from London City and visit this special area for an ideal vacation filled with nature and relaxation.

_**Main attractions:** Walking trails along the cliffs, Beachy Head, Cuckmere Haven, and Seven Sisters Country Park_
_**Best time to visit:** Late spring to early autumn for mild weather and beautiful views from the cliffs._

### **12. Warwick Castle**

**![Warwick Castle](https://imagecdnpro.com//Images/25092024071502.webp)**

_**Location: 100 miles northwest of London**_
_**Distance: 1.5 hours by train**_

Plan to visit Warwick Castle and enjoy the spectacular medieval architecture of the fortress. This amazing castle offers a fun-filled outing near London and has to much history and activities for friends, family, and history enthusiasts. Go there for an amazing journey through beautiful gardens and experience the live reenactments of medieval life. You will also see some jousting tournaments and the spooky dungeon of the castle with a spine-chilling tale of history.
_**Best way to get there:** Direct train from London Marylebone to Warwick_
_**Main attractions:** Warwick Castle, The Castle Dungeon, Falconry displays, Jousting tournaments_
_**Best time to visit:** Summer for outdoor fun and better weather_

### **Conclusion**

Going to London for more than a week and still do not have an itinerary planned out?
